name: indian-tax-drafting
description: Open-source Claude-compatible plugin for drafting Indian direct-tax appellate litigation pleadings and statutory registrations under the Income-tax Act 1961. Case-config-aware design — structural skeletons follow the statutory Form layouts (Form 35 under Rule 45, Form 36 under Rule 47, Form 10A under Rule 17A) and the parties' chosen forum (Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) / Income-tax Appellate Tribunal / High Court Tax Bench / Principal Commissioner or Commissioner of Income-tax for registration and revision / Dispute Resolution Panel), assessment year, financial year, limitation anchor, assessment-order vintage (pre-Finance-Act-2021 reassessment regime vs Section 148A regime), faceless-vs-physical jurisdiction, and demand-notice / penalty-notice trajectory are supplied by the user via a case-config file. Battle-tested workflows for CIT(Appeals) Form 35 appeal under Section 246A, ITAT Form 36 appeal under Section 253, High Court appeal on substantial questions of law under Section 260A, Section 12A / 12AB charitable-trust registration via Form 10A, objection to Section 148A(b) reassessment show-cause notice, reply to Section 271 / 270A penalty notice, objection to Section 263 PCIT / CIT revision against assessee, taxpayer-initiated revision before PCIT / CIT under Section 264, reply to Section 201 / 201(1A) TDS-default proceedings, and Dispute Resolution Panel objection under Section 144C. Includes the 6-agent drafting pipeline (Reader -> Format -> Drafter -> Verifier -> Refiner -> Overseer), shared tax drafting base with Income-tax Act 1961 + Income-tax Rules 1962 + Income-tax (Appellate Tribunal) Rules 1963 + Faceless Appeal Scheme 2021 + Faceless Assessment Scheme 2020 + Finance Act 2021 reassessment overhaul (Section 148A) + CBDT public-domain Circulars + Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 + Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 discipline encoded.
